rules.statement: It is too late to raise an objection as to the absence of a certificate from the Conciliation Board if an interlocutory decree has been already entered, even assuming such a certificate is necessary in a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: Even assuming that a certificate from the Conciliation Board is necessary in a partition action, it would be too late to raise an objection as to the absence of such certificate if interlocutory decree has been already entered.
